response.text:
I can do that, but overwriting a shared document is destructive and visible to others — I need to confirm details before proceeding.

Please provide and confirm the following:

1. Target document — exact name and location (URL, path, or document ID).  
2. Confirm overwrite — type one of these exact phrases to authorize:  
   - "Yes — overwrite [document name]"  
   - or "CONFIRM publish [document name]"  
3. Backup preference — create a timestamped backup copy of the current shared original before publishing? (recommended: Yes / No)  
4. Notification — notify collaborators after publishing? If yes, give preferred message or choose a default notification ("The policy has been updated. Please review."). Also say whether to send by email or in-app notification.  
5. Optional: a short change log or summary to include in the published document (1–3 lines).

Once you supply the document identifier and type the exact confirmation phrase, I will proceed (and will report back the result). If you want, I can instead prepare the backup and a preview of the publish action for you to review before final confirmation. Which do you prefer?
